reason: Conversation 2 immediately and correctly explained 22E as the fridge evaporator fan fault (likely iced), gave the sensible first step of a full unplugged manual defrost with food-handling and 'unplug first' safety, and when the code recurred correctly escalated to an engineer for defrost heater/sensor, with no unsupported part purchase or refrigerant-leak claims. Conversation 1 never explained what 22E means, repeatedly misread the customer's answers ('didn't quite catch'), mislabelled '9C' as a code, pushed a generic door-open/settings/vents/seals script despite clear answers, and after ten turns had still not proposed a defrost or escalation. Conversation 2's one minor weakness was mentioning the drain hole as a check the customer could not safely reach and calling the heater/thermostat 'sealed-system' components, but it quickly retracted and told them not to force panels.
